title: Cranberry Orange Spritz
description: Tart cranberry and sweet orange with a splash of sparkling water.
steps: Fill two glasses with ice. Add ¼ cup cranberry juice and ¼ cup orange juice to each.
Top each with ½ cup sparkling water, stir gently, and garnish each glass with an orange slice.
imageAlt: Red cranberry-orange spritz over ice with an orange slice
